Support your health and environmental goals with our bike leasing program through [BikeLeasing.AT](https://bikeleasing.at/arbeitnehmer#c2991), offering tax-efficient access to quality bicycles.

**Key Features**

- Lower cost than purchasing thanks to tax advantages
- Monthly salary deduction, usually over 36 months
- Pre-tax deduction reduces your taxable income
- Promotes healthy commuting and environmental responsibility
- **Early Termination:** If you resign before the end of the leasing period, options include paying remaining balance, purchasing bike, or transferring to new employer

**How to Access:** Contact [Global Expansion team](mailto:gx_employeeexperience@globalexpansion.com) for enrollment details

Statutory Pension & Life Insurance

**Pension:** You're covered by Austria's unified pension system under The Act on the Harmonisation of Austrian Pension Systems. This comprehensive national program calculates your pension based on your contribution duration and amounts. With at least 180 months (15 years) of contributions, you'll qualify for pension benefits that support your retirement security.

**Life Insurance:** Your protection is already built into Austria's social security framework, which provides coverage for illness, injury, and disability - ensuring you have comprehensive support through the national system.

[Relocation > Relocation / Address Change > Importance of Communicating Location > Short-Term Stay Definition]
If you are not changing your permanent location (where you maintain permanent residency), but instead are traveling to different locations over a period of time, you are responsible for maintaining your health insurance, visas, and any other item directly relating to your travel. Consider discussing your travel plans with your medical providers so that you can be aware of the resouces available to you, should you need them.

Since any short-term stay is your decision and not required by GitLab as part of your role, you will not be eligible to use the [Business Accident Travel Policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#business-travel-emergency-assistance--accident-policy) or submit any expenses related to your travel. If you are hired in a role requiring a time zone alignment, you must still be able to fulfill that requirement.

If your short-term stay is for less than 6 months in a new location, there should be no need to update your address in Workday.
